reconcile.note: Gill treats the shifting order and different closing item in each list as inconsequential rearrangement, since Paul himself reorders these commandments elsewhere.

sides.snippet: 'Honor your father and mother.' And, 'You shall love your neighbor as yourself.'
sides.verseText: 'Honor your father and mother.' And, 'You shall love your neighbor as yourself.'\"

sides.snippet: 'Do not defraud,' 'Honor your father and mother.'
sides.verseText: You know the commandments: 'Do not murder,' 'Do not commit adultery,' 'Do not steal,' 'Do not give false testimony,' 'Do not defraud,' 'Honor your father and mother.'\"
